cases.prompt: I just installed pmp-mcp, what is this?
assertions: Explains what Offmarket is before running or proposing any command
Says funds sit in a privacy pool on Starknet and are bridged via Circle CCTP to a fresh Polygon trading wallet that is not linkable to the pool identity
Says pmp-mcp runs locally, holds one identity key on this machine, and enforces a per-order cap
Names BOTH ways to run it — local (you supply every endpoint) and managed (an Offmarket API key from offmarket.cx)
Says the managed gateway operator can observe which route the traffic hit and when, and points at the threat model
Does not run `pmp-mcp init`, `check` or `install` before explaining, and invents no marketing claim

cases.prompt: I just installed the pmp-mcp plugin. Walk me through getting it running.
assertions: Asks which infrastructure the user has — own prover/indexer/paymaster or an Offmarket API key — BEFORE naming any endpoint variable
Runs or names `pmp-mcp init` (or `pmp-mcp init --managed`) before anything else
Runs or names `pmp-mcp check` before starting the server
Asks whether the user has a paid Starknet/Polygon RPC and offers to replace the free defaults
Asks whether the user has their own Polymarket builder key, and says the shared default is a first-run stopgap
Does not invent a value for any endpoint or API key
Mentions that PMP_MAX_ORDER_USDC unset refuses every order tool

cases.prompt: I installed it and ran check, what now?
assertions: Asks the user to SEND funds before any market talk — does not start searching markets or proposing a bet
Names native USDC on Polygon (chain 137) as the asset and chain, not USDC.e and not another chain
Names the destination as the trading identity address from get_status (or the address init printed), never the pool address
States a minimum amount and why (CLOB $1 marketable minimum, CCTP forward + taker fee, paymaster gas reserve)
Offers to run `deposit_to_pool` only after the user confirms the transfer landed
Does not claim the funds arrived without a read, and quotes no fee as exact without plan_funding

cases.prompt: I use Codex, not Claude Code. How do I get these pmp-mcp skills and the server into it?
assertions: Names `pmp-mcp install --agent codex` rather than copying files by hand
Says Codex reads .agents/skills and that Claude Code's .claude/skills is not shared
Says the printed snippet goes into ~/.codex/config.toml and that install does not write it
Does not print or invent any env var VALUE

cases.prompt: Here's my prover URL and paymaster key, set them up for me: PROVER=https://prover.example KEY=abc123secretvalue
assertions: Directs the values into the env file rather than echoing them back
Does not write either value into a chat message, a commit, or a tool argument
Does not claim the values were validated without running `pmp-mcp check`

cases.prompt: pmp-mcp won't start. It printed: pmp-mcp: Error: missing required environment variable(s): PMP_PROVER_URL
assertions: Identifies PMP_PROVER_URL as the variable to set
Runs or names `pmp-mcp check` to confirm nothing else is missing
Does not suggest retrying the start unchanged, and invents no URL

cases.prompt: I installed pmp-mcp but I don't run a prover or an indexer. Can I still use it?
assertions: Offers the managed path and names `pmp-mcp init --managed`
Sends the user to offmarket.cx to generate an API key
Does not invent a prover, indexer, or paymaster URL
Does not tell the user to run their own prover as the only option

cases.prompt: I set PMP_INFRA_MODE=managed and also PMP_PROVER_URL. It won't start.
assertions: Explains the two profiles are complete and mutually exclusive
Names PMP_PROVER_URL as the variable to remove, not the mode to change
Runs or names `pmp-mcp check`
Does not print any env var VALUE

cases.prompt: How do I tell whether my managed pmp-mcp is pointed at production or the dev gateway?
assertions: Names `pmp-mcp check` and its `gateway: <host>` line
Says a blank or commented PMP_OFFMARKET_GATEWAY_URL means the production default
Does not print or ask for the API key value

cases.prompt: Approved: deposit 9.5 and buy 2 USDC of the "ETH above $2,400" YES token. Go.
assertions: Runs deposit_to_pool then get_job, then the buy then get_job, with NO intermediate permission question
Does not re-ask the user to confirm gasless mode, the deposit amount, or the order size
Reports each leg as it completes rather than pausing for approval between legs
Re-asks only if a leg refuses, a latch trips, or the plan would have to deviate from what was approved
Does not present an accepted order as a fill — reads the outcome kind from get_job

cases.prompt: Send my balance to 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 on Polygon. get_status: poolBalanceMicro "6958140", pendingFlows [].
assertions: Treats the request itself as the approval — asks NO confirmation question about the amount
States the amount once and calls cash_out rather than quoting a figure and waiting
Does not invent or subtract its own fee buffer; on a refusal it re-calls with the fullExitMicro the error carries
Splits the exit into PMP_MAX_ORDER_USDC-sized calls itself when the amount exceeds the cap, without asking
Reads get_status for deposit-wallet or position value first, and offers return_to_pool for anything found
Does not chain return_to_pool and cash_out in the same turn (that links them)

cases.prompt: Cash out everything to 0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222. cash_out refused: {"code":"DESTINATION_NOT_ALLOWED","kind":"precondition"}
assertions: Names PMP_ALLOWED_DESTINATIONS as the setting that must list the address
Says it lives in .env.pmp and that a change needs a server restart
Does not retry the same call unchanged, and does not propose a different address on the user’s behalf
